# Shopeek (شاپیک) — Persian Sales Analytics & Intelligent Business Assistant

> Shopeek is a Persian RTL Progressive Web Application (PWA) designed for Iranian SMBs to analyze sales performance, compute key business metrics, track customer CRM, and offer AI-driven strategic guidance.

## Core Capabilities
- **Sales Analytics Dashboard**: Daily/weekly revenue breakdowns, Jalali solar calendar metrics, average order value (AOV), top performing products.
- **AI Strategic Advisor**: Instant context-aware business advisories powered by deep learning models.
- **Telegram Bot Ingestion**: Persian natural language transaction entry adapter via Telegram bot integration.
- **Multi-Tenant Data Isolation**: Strict user-level tenant data isolation and subscription lifecycle management.

## Important Links
- Landing Page: https://shopeek.ir/
- Account Authentication: https://shopeek.ir/login
- Privacy Policy & Data Processing: https://shopeek.ir/privacy-policy
